notes.title: 🚒 Firefighter Frankie - Major Update
notes.content: [p]Hi everyone,[/p][p]A new update is live for Firefighter Frankie! 🐾 This one adds fresh content and a bunch of fixes to make the game smoother:[/p][h3]🔥 5 New Fires[/h3][list][*][p]Firestation Windhaven:[/p][list][*][p]Stadium[/p][/*][*][p]House[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Firestation Crimon Canyon:[/p][list][*][p]Cabin[/p][/*][*][p]Space Shuttle[/p][/*][*][p]Steam Locomotive[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h3]🎮 Fixes & Improvements[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed load save bug Windhaven[/p][/*][*][p]Patched tunnels and map gaps[/p][/*][*][p]Improved performance[/p][/*][/list][p]Thanks again for playing and for all the feedback! It really helps me polish the game and make Frankie’s adventure better for everyone.[/p][p]Tom - PyroPeak Studios[/p]

notes.title: 🚒 Firefighter Frankie - Update
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

Thanks for playing Firefighter Frankie! 🐾 I’ve been working on fixes and small improvements since launch:

[list]
[*] 🐱 Adjusted cat placement so they can be collected correctly
[*] 🔥 New Endless Mode after finishing the story (Fires keep reigniting)
[*] 🚒 Fixed utility pole, refinery, pumpjack, and airplane fires
[*] 🎮 Clearer Molotov mission
[*] 🌍 Better collisions, navigation, and translations
[/list]

More polish and updates are coming, thanks for your support and feedback!

Tom - PyroPeak Studios

notes.title: 🚒 Firefighter Frankie is out now! 🐾
notes.content:
[p][b]Firefighter Frankie[/b] is officially released on Steam! Play as Frankie the dog and help protect the city from fires. Put out flames, unlock upgrades, and collect hidden cats as you progress through the fire stations.[/p][p]What to expect:[/p][list][*][p]🌆 Three unique fire stations[/p][/*][*][p]🐱 50 hidden cats to collect[/p][/*][*][p]🚒 Upgrades, gadgets, and firefighting tech[/p][/*][*][p]⏱️ A tightly crafted 1-2 hour adventure[/p][/*][/list][p]Thank you so much to everyone who supported the game during development. I hope you enjoy Frankie’s journey!

Tom - PyroPeak Studios[/p]

notes.title: Release Date Announcement
notes.content:
[p]I'm excited to announce that the game will launch on [b]September 19, 2025 – 16:00 CEST (07:00 PDT)[/b]! [/p][p]The full release will start with a [b]20% launch discount[/b]. The base price is [b]$1.99 USD[/b] (regional prices will be shown automatically in your local currency on Steam).
[/p][p]Thank you for all your support! I can’t wait to see you on launch day!

Tom - PyroPeak Studios[/p]

notes.title: Steam Next Fest & New Demo!
notes.content:
[p]Hey everyone![/p][p]I'm excited to announce that my game is featured in [b]Steam Next Fest[/b], starting in just a few hours! To celebrate, I’ve released a major update to the demo, packed with exciting new features and improvements based on your feedback.
[/p][h2]🌟 What's New in the Demo?[/h2][p][b]Changelog – Major Demo Update[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Added a new mini-game[/b] for filling the water tank, introducing additional gameplay variety.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Implemented a cat collection feature,[/b] allowing players to find and collect cats throughout the map.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Enabled CO₂ refilling[/b] via pickupable items.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Enhanced tutorials[/b] to improve onboarding and overall player guidance.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Various improvements and bug fixes[/b] to enhance stability, performance, and user experience.[/p][/*][/list][p]I can’t wait for you to try out these new features and let me know what you think! Your feedback is invaluable as I continue to shape the game.
[/p][h2]🕹️ How to Play[/h2][p]Download the updated demo now and join me during Steam Next Fest! Don’t forget to wishlist and follow the game to stay up-to-date with all the latest news.[/p][p]Thank you for your amazing support, and [b]good luck, firefighter![/b]

Tom - PyroPeak Studios[/p]
